audit.whatIsWrong: Multiple fields claim Wind Wall blocks Focused Resolve (W) / the empowered Mantra snare (RW).
audit.why: Riot's text for Focused Resolve reads 'creates a tether between herself and a targeted enemy' — it is a targeted tether, not a projectile, so Wind Wall cannot eat it. Only Inner Flame (Q) is a projectile (kit flag: projectile). The tether breaks on distance instead: W range is 675, so dashing out with Sweeping Blade is the real answer. The mirror audit on Karma's page reached the same conclusion.
audit.corrected: Wind Wall eats Inner Flame (Q); Focused Resolve (W) is targeted and must be broken by leaving 675 range. W is on a flat 12s cooldown at every rank — that gap is the trade window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart gave Yasuo rows 3, 4 and 6-7 and called row 2 a skill test; the mirrored Karma audit already set rows 1, 2, 3, 5 to Karma and row 4 to Skill.
audit.why: Both directions must agree. Karma out-ranges Yasuo with a 950-range Inner Flame until Sweeping Blade is online, and even after level 3 a landed Focused Resolve wins her the trade, so the early rows belong to her.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 3, 5 = Karma; row 4 = Skill; rows 6, 7 = Yasuo. Proposed as matched full/content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[1..3].why and whys[1..3] described a Yasuo-favoured lane from level 3 and repeated the Wind Wall error.
audit.why: Spikes must key to the real cooldown: Focused Resolve is 12s flat, Inner Flame drops 9s to 5s, and Yasuo's own spike is the crit-item flip, not level 3.
audit.corrected: Rewrote the level-2 to 4-5 phases around the 12s Focused Resolve window and the item spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds mention despite the flagged missing interaction.
audit.why: Mantra-empowered Focused Resolve heals Karma while it tethers, which decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: Added Executioner's Calling against Mantra-W to the itemization line.

audit.whatIsWrong: Karma referred to as 'his'/'he' in several full-layer strings.
audit.why: Karma is female; the page reads as boilerplate.
audit.corrected: Fixed in the strings being rewritten.

edits.after: From level 3 you can finally reach her. Sweeping Blade off a minion erases her range advantage, and Wind Wall deletes Inner Flame (Q) — but Focused Resolve (W) is a targeted tether no wall stops, so break it by dashing away past 675 range.
